poster.hook: For the theft of the Saltmere bell. Last seen rowing east.

story.appearance: Lean, grey-green orc with a split lower tusk, rope-burned palms, and a fisherman's knit cap he never takes off. Moves like he's always about to leave.
story.concept: Rook grew up on Saltmere's docks, half-drowned once and half-starved most of the time. He climbs anything, opens anything, and owes money to everyone. A stranger in a sea-green coat paid him forty gold to cut the bell down and row it to the smugglers' cave. Nobody said anything about the dead.
story.stake: He did this. Every corpse that walks up the beach tonight is his fault, and everyone is about to find out.
story.goal: Get the bell back before anyone learns who took it — or at least before Vell does.
story.secret: He kept the stranger's payment: a coin stamped with a drowned woman's face. It's warm to the touch, and since he took it he's been dreaming of the bottom of the bay.
story.voice: Quick, deflecting, funny when cornered. Never answers a question with a straight answer if a joke is available.
mannerisms: Flips a coin across his knuckles when nervous (it's always the same coin)
Checks every exit when he enters a room
story.trinket: A drowned woman's coin, warm to the touch

ties.text: She pulled him from the surf when he was nine. He's terrified she knows what he did.
ties.public: She pulled him from the surf when he was nine

ties.text: Marrow broke his arm once over a debt. They've been grudging friends ever since.
ties.public: Marrow broke his arm once; grudging friends since

story.intro: "Rook. I do odd jobs. Very odd. Don't ask about the last one."

features.name: Adrenaline Rush
features.text: Bonus Action: take the Dash action and gain 3 Temporary HP.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.text: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead.

features.name: Alert
features.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative. After rolling Initiative you can swap your result with a willing ally's.

features.name: Sneak Attack (3d6)
features.text: Once per turn, deal an extra 3d6 damage with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage, or an ally is within 5 ft of the target and you don't have Disadvantage.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.text: Bonus Action: give yourself Advantage on your next attack this turn, if you haven't moved. Your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.text: When you deal Sneak Attack damage you can give up dice for an effect: Poison (1d6, Con save or Poisoned 1 min), Trip (1d6, Dex save or Prone, Large or smaller), Withdraw (1d6, move half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks). Save DC 15.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.text: Reaction: when an attacker you can see hits you, halve the damage.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.text: Bonus Action: Sleight of Hand check, use Thieves' Tools to disarm a trap or pick a lock, or take the Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.text: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and you can use Dexterity instead of Strength to determine your jump distance.
